response.sql: WITH source_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS funding_source, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), source_stats AS (SELECT funding_source, project_count, AVG(project_count * 1.0) OVER () AS average_count, SUM(project_count) OVER () AS total_count FROM source_counts) SELECT funding_source, project_count, project_count * 1.0 / total_count AS share, project_count - average_count AS exceeds_average FROM source_stats WHERE project_count > average_count;
